shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 3 'dashboard|chart|drag|grid' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' src/main.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit@latest peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit versions --json'

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit Dashboard Grid && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Card Select'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit Dashboard Grid && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Card Select'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '## DashKit component|DashKit component|editMode|onChange|plugin' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60 && sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md && rg -n -C 4 'defaultLayout|renderer|type: .custom.|registerPlugins' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -180 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | head -50 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit | rg 'styles|css' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts && rg -n 'export.*DashKit|registerPlugins|interface Plugin|type Plugin|renderer' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -80 && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/index.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/plugin.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/index.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'dashkit.*css|DashKit.css|styles.css|\\.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -100 && rg -n -C 4 'DashKit.setSettings|registerPlugins\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface ChartAxisLabels|type ChartAxisLabels|labels\\?:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types -g '*.d.ts' | head -40 && rg -n -C 4 'labels:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-labels.md | head -80 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/config/axis.d.ts 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-text-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u && git status --short && git diff --stat && sed -n '1,120p' index.html"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})\" && git status --short && cat package.json && git diff --check"
